PlayerProgress.title: PlayerProgress
PlayerProgress.description: Cloud-saved Pagade campaign progress, unlocked stages, Glory points, and match preferences for an authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

highestUnlockedLevel.description: Highest unlocked stage in the endless Pagade campaign.

autoMoveSingle.description: Whether to automatically move when only 1 legal move exists.

fastSpeed.description: Whether 2x fast match animation speed is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent progress sync.

AdminGrant.title: AdminGrant
AdminGrant.description: Authorized administrator email grant allowing access to the Development & Production GitHub Server Sync Console.

email.description: Lowercase email address granted admin server sync privileges.

addedBy.description: Email of the super-admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/players/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated player's cloud-synced Pagade campaign progress, keyed by their Firebase Auth UID.

/admin_emails/{emailId}.description: Stores delegated admin email grants, keyed by normalized email ID, accessible only to verified admins.
